title: Jackhammer, outdoors (gloved)
look_at: Both "gloved hand" boxes are on the ear defenders and the "bare hand" box is on the tool pouch; the yellow-gloved hands themselves are missed. Outdoor, eye-level photos are unlike the overhead factory cameras it was trained on.

title: Red work glove, close-up
look_at: The only box is a "bare hand" on the worker's head; the large red glove is missed. Close-ups are far from the training data, where hands are small and seen from above.

credit.title: Man works with glass in a factory setting wearing gloves and focusing on his task.jpg
credit.author: Shixart1985

title: Handling a metal sheet (gloved)
look_at: Nothing detected, though a red-gloved hand is in view.

credit.title: Worker handling a metal sheet in a manufacturing facility.jpg
credit.author: Shixart1985

title: Welding (gloved)
look_at: Nothing detected: thick welding gloves seen close up never appear in the training data.

title: Lab, nitrile gloves
look_at: Nothing detected on two clearly gloved hands.

title: Machine operator (bare hands)
look_at: Nothing detected: the bare hands holding a phone are missed. Missed bare hands are this model's main failure, even on its own validation data.

credit.title: A worker operates a machine while checking a mobile device in a workshop setting.jpg
credit.author: Shixart1985

title: Salt workers, distant (bare hands)
look_at: One "gloved hand" box, on the basket. The workers' hands are tiny; small hands are found 6-25% of the time even on training-like data.

title: Tools, no hands
look_at: Correctly empty: no hands, no boxes.
